note: Create these 6 templates in Meta Business Manager > WhatsApp Manager > Message Templates. Wait for approval BEFORE using them for business-initiated messages. Use English (en) first, then add Urdu (ur) as a second language on the same template. {{1}}, {{2}} are variables — fill them in the API call. Do NOT put payment numbers in a template.

templates.body_en: Assalam-o-Alaikum {{1}}! Welcome to Kisan Dost. Your plan: {{2}}. Start: {{3}}. Expiry: {{4}}. You have a FREE 7-day trial. Please save our number so you receive Broadcast messages.
templates.body_ur: Assalam-o-Alaikum {{1}}! Kisan Dost mein khush amdeed. Aap ka plan: {{2}}. Shuru: {{3}}. Khatam: {{4}}. 7 din FREE trial hai. Broadcast milne ke liye hamara number save kar lein.
templates.name: kisan_welcome

templates.body_en: To continue Kisan Dost after your trial, please pay {{1}} PKR for your {{2}} plan. Pay by JazzCash or UBL Bank Transfer. Payment details will be sent to you privately on WhatsApp. After paying, send your Transaction ID here.
templates.body_ur: Trial ke baad Kisan Dost jaari rakhne ke liye {{2}} plan ke liye {{1}} PKR ada karein. JazzCash ya UBL Bank Transfer se ada karein. Payment details aap ko alag WhatsApp par bheji jayengi. Ada karne ke baad apni Transaction ID yahan bhejein.
templates.name: kisan_payment_instructions

templates.body_en: Payment received! Your Kisan Dost {{1}} plan is now Active. Start: {{2}}. Expiry: {{3}}. Thank you!
templates.body_ur: Payment mil gayi! Aap ka Kisan Dost {{1}} plan ab Active hai. Shuru: {{2}}. Khatam: {{3}}. Shukriya!
templates.name: kisan_payment_success

templates.body_en: Kisan Dost alert for {{1}} farmers in {{2}}: {{3}}
templates.body_ur: {{2}} mein {{1}} ke kisano ke liye Kisan Dost alert: {{3}}
templates.cost_note: This is a business-initiated Utility template. In Pakistan Meta charges about $0.015 per delivered message (about PKR 4). It is NOT free after the 1,000 free service replies. Send 2-3 times a week, not every day, to keep cost low.

example.3: First irrigation after 20-25 days. Do not over-water in fog.

templates.name: kisan_daily_alert
variables: alert_text — keep short, one advice only

templates.body_en: Assalam-o-Alaikum {{1}}! Your Kisan Dost {{2}} plan expires on {{3}}. Please renew by paying {{4}} PKR by JazzCash or UBL Bank Transfer, and send your Transaction ID here.
templates.body_ur: Assalam-o-Alaikum {{1}}! Aap ka Kisan Dost {{2}} plan {{3}} ko khatam ho raha hai. Baraye meharbani {{4}} PKR JazzCash ya UBL Bank Transfer se ada kar ke Transaction ID yahan bhejein.
templates.name: kisan_renewal_reminder
